name: agent-custody
uses: Gateway between agents and their tools that checks each MCP, REST or A2A call against a Cedar or Rego policy and writes a signed, offline-verifiable receipt for allowed and denied calls.
next_gate: Trial in observe mode on one sandboxed lane's MCP calls under $PFY_TMP, receipts compared with the lane cage logs; audit only, never a replacement for the cage. No Feature GO.
